settings.heading: What are the weight and dimensions of the grill?
settings.text: This is our product dimension: 22.0"D x 53.0"W x 45.5"H, item weight: (Mesa305)81.5 Pounds (Mesa325)84.5 Pounds.

settings.heading: Does the grill come with a propane hose?
settings.text: The grill includes a hose to connect to 20lb Propane Tank.

settings.heading: What is the size of my grill shelf?
settings.text: The area of a single shelf in our Mesa series can reach 227 sqin.

settings.heading: Can I build my Mesa grill in?
settings.text: The Mesa grill can not be used as a built in grill for an outdoor/indoor kitchen as there dangers in reforming a freestanding grill.

settings.heading: Does this grill need assembly when it arrives?
settings.text: The grill requires assembly upon arrival.

settings.heading: Can I use natural gas to light my MESA grill?
settings.text: No, Mesa only supports Liquid Propane.

settings.heading: Can all four wheels of the NEW MESA be turned?
settings.text: Yes, for ease of mobility, we have equipped the MESA series with four steerable wheels.
